moonlightIOS.scope: Full upstream archive and pinned core/ENet/nanors/X1Kit. Client compiled into iOS with separately retained adapted source copies.

moonlightCore.scope: Full upstream archive including pinned ENet and nanors.

sunshine.scope: Reference upstream source archive for attribution. The current Mac runtime is built from the revision, additional input revision and patches in Engines/Desktop/release.json and Engines/Desktop/Patches; this reference archive alone is not complete corresponding source.

integration.moonlight: iOS target compiles upstream sources and MoonlightCore static library, with native SwiftUI setup and upstream stream/input/audio/decoder view controller.
integration.sunshine: Mac target bundles the locally built desktop candidate selected by Config/Generated.xcconfig. Exact revisions, patches and dependency inputs are recorded in Engines/Desktop; the staged runtime contains provenance and notices.
integration.runtimeProvenance: Staged desktop runtime PROVENANCE.json (path selected by Config/Generated.xcconfig)
integration.validation: Compilation is not end-to-end streaming validation. See docs/VALIDATION.md.
